aviation_incidents.headline: 美軍第4架UH-60M黑鷹NFL賽前飛越時煙火在機旁爆炸 直升機續飛且未見明顯損傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 2026年11月2日，美軍4架UH-60M黑鷹在西雅圖流明球場NFL賽前飛越；第4架仍在球場附近時煙火施放並在機旁爆炸，是否有投射物接觸機身未明。直升機隨後續飛，未見明顯損傷；是否已檢查該機仍未獲確認。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: The fourth US Army UH-60M Black Hawk continues without visible damage after fireworks explode nearby during an NFL flyover
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On November 2, 2026, four US Army UH-60M Black Hawks performed a pregame flyover at Seattle’s Lumen Field. Fireworks erupted while the fourth helicopter was still nearby and exploded extremely close to it; whether any projectile contacted the aircraft remains unclear. The helicopter continued behind the formation with no visible damage, and it was not confirmed whether it had been inspected.

international_aviation.headline: 美國聯邦航空總署下令檢查部分波音787中央翼油箱密封膠 缺陷恐提高雷擊時油箱爆炸風險
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署於2026年11月2日發布適航指令，要求檢查部分波音787-8、787-9及787-10的中央翼油箱密封膠，因相關安裝缺少必要的黏著測試證據。該署警告，缺陷密封膠可能在雷擊時形成引火源並增加油箱爆炸風險；業者須於指令生效後12個月內完成檢查及未驗證部位的黏著測試，缺陷依核准程序修復。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA orders inspections of certain Boeing 787 center-wing tank sealant over lightning-strike explosion risk
international_aviation.summary_en: On November 2, 2026, the FAA issued an airworthiness directive requiring inspections of center wing fuel tank sealant on certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft because required adhesion-test evidence was missing. The agency warned that defective sealant could create an ignition source during a lightning strike and increase explosion risk. Operators must complete inspections and tests of unverified areas within 12 months of the directive’s effective date, and repair defects under approved procedures.

international_aviation.headline: 加拿大航空明年不恢復多倫多—孟買航線 印度航空接手後加航印度航點僅剩德里
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空明年不恢復多倫多皮爾遜—孟買航線，印度航空將接手；印度飛往加拿大一程將經羅馬中停，回程預計直飛。調整後德里將是加航在印度唯一航點，多倫多全年直飛德里，蒙特婁則有季節性航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada will not resume Toronto–Mumbai service next year, and Air India will take over as Delhi becomes its only India destination
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada will not resume its Toronto Pearson–Mumbai route next year, and Air India will take it over. The India-to-Canada leg will stop in Rome; nonstop return service is expected. Delhi will be Air Canada’s only destination in India, with year-round nonstop flights from Toronto and seasonal service from Montreal.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍處置測試飛行員學校3架A-29C Super Tucano 尋求尾旋訓練及任務系統教學替代方案
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍已處置愛德華基地測試飛行員學校3架A-29C Super Tucano，評估認定機型不符該校需求，正尋找尾旋訓練及任務系統教學替代方案。空軍測試中心2026年10月29日公告擬安排地面處置與隨叫隨到維護，明確排除恢復飛行維護，該批飛機預計不再飛行。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force divests three A-29C Super Tucanos from Test Pilot School, seeks alternatives for spin training and mission-systems instruction
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Air Force has divested three A-29C Super Tucanos assigned to the Test Pilot School at Edwards Air Force Base after determining they did not meet the school’s requirements. It is seeking alternatives for spin training and mission-systems instruction. An Air Force Test Center notice of intent issued October 29, 2026, proposed ground handling and on-call maintenance but excluded return-to-flight work, indicating the aircraft are not expected to fly again.
